philosophy.description: Rules are enforced when explicitly defined by project taxonomy/config. Undefined governance stays disabled.
philosophy.runtime_contract: The motor coordinates agents through local JSON artifacts. It does not execute Git commands for agents.

principles: cargo check is the login event
worktrees are registered only by their own runtime execution
agent_id is the stable 8-character identity used in communication
internal_id is kept as a simple numeric compatibility identifier
Git/VCS metadata must be provided by the AI through explicit CLI parameters

git_policy.future_external_layer: Git hooks and GitHub/GitLab branch protection belong to Passo 8, after the motor contract is stable.

status.description: Render global swarm status in text or JSON.
Render the current reconciled agent identity, active_task_* governance metadata, local operational state, next action hint, and stale_reason when a submit/task is stale.
Return the next expected action plus submit metadata, active_task_* governance metadata, stale_reason, and root decision note when available.
Refresh governance from the current audit and then render root-only orchestration findings explicitly.
Root-only: release governance and manager-task claims held by stale agents without deleting agent identities.
Root-only: remove stale idle agents from connected.json without deleting their login files.
Inspect an agent by numeric internal_id.
Inspect an agent by stable 8-character agent_id.

messages.description: Send a public directed message to a stable agent_id.
Send a message with explicit sender and recipient identity.
Store a public broadcast message for all agents.
Render a filtered public message thread.
Render messages addressed to the current agent.

feedback.description: Store pedagogical or operational feedback with current agent identity.
Store sync feedback with explicit VCS metadata.

submit.description: Create canonical submit evidence: public message, feedback entry, and submit queue record.
List consumed, stale, superseded, accepted, rejected, and closed submit records.
Inspect one submit record including stale_reason.
Root-only: mark a submit accepted and release its task claim when applicable.
Root-only: close a submit after integration or manual handling.

manager_tasks.description: Create a priority task that overrides ordinary governance backlog.
Close a manager task and allow normal governance work to resume.

governance.description: Evaluate persisted sync metadata and explain whether the agent must refresh context.

installation.description: Materialize project-local plugin configuration and build guard templates.
Materialize managed local hook templates plus explicit merge/push metadata templates under AC_Ant-Delirium_props without executing external VCS commands.
Validate AC_Ant-Delirium_props/orchestration/merge_request.json against the required explicit metadata contract.
Validate AC_Ant-Delirium_props/orchestration/push_request.json against the required explicit metadata contract.
Render installation and bootstrap guidance from runtime context.

submit_states.none: No submit evidence is present for the current agent.
submit_states.message_only: A public submit message exists without matching feedback or queue record.
submit_states.feedback_only: Submit feedback exists without matching public message.
submit_states.ready_for_root: Canonical submit evidence is complete and open for root review.
submit_states.blocked_rebase: Persisted sync metadata says the agent must refresh branch/revision context.
submit_states.blocked_task_version: Submit is based on stale governance task metadata.
submit_states.consumed: Root already accepted, rejected, or closed the latest submit.

action_hints.triage_active_submits: Root should inspect open submits and decide accept/reject/close.
action_hints.dispatch_manager_priority: Root has unassigned manager priority work.
action_hints.await_agent_claims: Root has unassigned governance work and should wait for agents.
action_hints.root_idle: Root has no active submit or unassigned backlog to triage.
action_hints.complete_manager_task: Agent must finish manager priority work before normal backlog.
action_hints.wait_root_triage: Agent already submitted and should wait for root decision.
action_hints.revise_rejected_submit: Root rejected the latest submit, but the claim is preserved so the agent should revise the assigned mission and resubmit.
action_hints.refresh_governance_task: Agent submit is stale and must refresh governance task state.
action_hints.refresh_sync_metadata: Agent must collect fresh branch/revision metadata.
action_hints.resume_backlog: Latest submit was consumed and agent can return to backlog.
action_hints.continue_assigned_mission: Agent should continue its assigned mission.
action_hints.resume_owned_governance: Agent should resume owned governance backlog.
action_hints.claim_next_work: Agent has no mission and should wait for assignment.

canonical_submit_lifecycle: Agent runs --whoami and confirms assigned mission, agent_id, branch and task metadata.
Agent reruns --whoami or --next-action and either waits, revises a rejected submit, refreshes stale work, continues active_task_* work, or resumes backlog.

rejected_submit_with_preserved_claim: Agent submit enters submit_queue.json as open and --next-action on root becomes triage_active_submits.
The original claim remains active so the agent can revise and resubmit without ambiguous reassignment.
stale_submit_after_governance_change: Agent submit enters submit_queue.json as open with task_id, task_version, task_revision and task_content_hash.
Root-side governance changes the same task and releases the old claim.
The open submit is marked status=stale and task_stale=true with stale_reason explaining version and content drift.
Root --next-action --json becomes action_code=review_stale_submit_tasks until the stale record is consumed.
clean_bootstrap_self_heals_old_sovereign: A new project runs config init and wires the generated build guard into build.rs before creating worktrees.
If an older governance.json still contains sovereign files such as plugins/<project>/ac_ant_delirium, AC_Ant-Delirium_props/ant_delirium_build_guard.rs, or build.rs, root reruns --root-checks.
The root command refreshes governance from the current audit before reporting findings, so stale sovereign backlog entries are removed from governance.json.
After that self-heal, swarm status shows open_governance_tasks=0 when no distributable backlog exists, and new worktrees log in without receiving sovereign-file missions.

stale_submit_recovery: If --whoami or --submits reports blocked_task_version with stale_reason, the agent must not resend the same stale submit.
Agent refreshes the governance task state from current runtime output.
Agent repeats submit only after the task_id, task_version, task_revision and task_content_hash match current governance data.
metadata_error_recovery: If sync or submit fails with metadata missing, collect branch, base_revision, workspace_revision and repository_revision externally.
branch is the current work branch name.
base_revision is the revision the workspace was based on.
workspace_revision is the current workspace revision, commit or content marker.
repository_revision is the current root/repository revision the agent must synchronize against.
Retry the same operation with explicit CLI parameters.
Do not expect the motor to execute Git commands or infer these revisions.

governance.legacy_backfill: Legacy governance tasks missing task_id, task_revision or task_content_hash are hydrated before submit evidence is recorded.

rules.status: documented as not fully implemented unless verified in engine/API

new_project_order: Install the generated build guard into build.rs files that must enforce the motor
Ensure sovereign files are present in main before creating worktrees
Run cargo check inside each worktree so each agent logs itself in
Use swarm status and --whoami to verify identity before assigning work
If a stale governance.json from an earlier bootstrap leaked sovereign files into backlog, rerun --root-checks to refresh governance before diagnosing root findings
bootstrap.generated_data_policy: Files under AC_Ant-Delirium_props/login are generated runtime identity data and should not be manually edited or copied between agents.

managed_git_hooks.activation: manual and external to the motor
current_policies: commit-msg requires the current stable agent_id plus an explicit submit_id in the commit message
pre-merge-commit requires local login.json plus explicit merge_request.json metadata
pre-push blocks pushes to refs/heads/main and requires explicit push_request.json metadata
